content.title: ABC cancels ‘The Bachelorette’ season 22 following footage of ‘SLOMW’ star Taylor Frankie Paul
content.text: If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation. By Mallory Dwortz | mdwortz@mlive.com “The Bachelorette” season 22 was originally scheduled to debut this Sunday, March 22 on ABC . The network has since pulled to upcoming season due to problematic footage of “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives” cast member Taylor Frankie Paul. Stream with Fubo About “The Bachelorette” Reality dating series “The Bachelorette” places one single woman in a mansion with a group of more than 20 eligible men, all of whom have arrived in search of a relationship. Throughout the show, the selected star gets to know each suitor, awarding red roses to potentially compatible partners, and sending the rest home. Related: Bachelor Mansion gets renovated in new HGTV competition series premiering March 2 Weekly activities include group dates, solo outings, and lavish trips. At the end of the approximately two-month filming period, “The Bachelorette” then decides which finalist, if any, will leave as her official boyfriend or fiancé. Who is Taylor Frankie Paul? Season 22 “Bachelorette” Taylor Frankie Paul hails from the Hulu reality series, “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives.” She was first known on TikTok for helping to found the Mormon internet friend group, MomTok, a collective of young Utah-based mothers pursuing entertainment careers while adhering to an at times rigid religious culture. Related: Will ‘The Bachelorette’ still air? ‘Secret Lives of Mormon Wives’ & Taylor Frankie Paul’s run as ABC leading lady Paul received “The Bachelorette” call as fellow “Mormon Wives” cast members also spread to other reality TV franchises. Co-stars Jen Affleck and Whitney Leavitt were recently featured on “Dancing with the Stars” season 34. Paul’s time on her home show this season has led to controversy leading up to the ABC premiere — mostly regarding her complicated relationship with ex-boyfriend Dakota Mortensen. Why was “The Bachelorette” cancelled? On the morning of March 18, the show was still set to air as scheduled , but as of Thursday, March 19 — only three days before the premiere — Taylor’s season has been officially removed from network programming. “In light of the newly released video just surfaced today, we have made the decision to not move forward with the new season of ‘The Bachelorette’ at this time, and our focus is on supporting the family,” revealed a Disney spokesperson, referring to a recently circulated recording of a heated encounter between Paul and Mortensen. The couple are reportedly involved in an “ongoing investigation,” sources told NBC’s TODAY , that was opened prior to the cancellation. How to watch: Although “The Bachelorette” season 22 will no longer premiere this Sunday, March 22, viewers can still access ABC with Fubo and DIRECTV.
